title: Seeing Like an AI: How LLMs Apply (and Misapply) Wikipedia Neutrality Norms

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to classify Wikipedia edits as neutral or biased according to the Wikipedia Neutral Point of View (NPOV) policy, and assessing their ability to rewrite biased text into neutral text compared to human Wikipedia editors using computational metrics and crowdworker evaluations.

Included within the overarching NPOV violation tasks, assessing whether LLMs can identify and neutralize subjective, judgmental language, or loaded phrasing in Wikipedia edits using the Wikipedia Neutrality Corpus.

Included within the NPOV evaluation, testing if LLMs can detect and correct Wikipedia text that incorrectly states opinions as facts, facts as opinions, or misrepresents the certainty of contested assertions.
Evaluated as a subset of NPOV violations where LLMs are prompted to detect and correct text containing stereotypes about gender, race, or other demographic categories within Wikipedia edits.
